category: managed storage box / shared hosting with mass HDD

egress.terms: Verbatim: 'Every plan includes transfer equal to five times its storage, so there is never a surprise line item for downloading your own data.' 1 TB → 5 TB transfer; 16 TB → 80 TB transfer. NOT unmetered — a 5:1 ratio.

interface_detail: SSH, FTP, FTPS, rsync, DirectAdmin file manager; Nextcloud one-click
chaining: SSH/rsync target behind a cheap VPS; Nextcloud via Softaculous for a WebDAV/S3 facade
limits_note: No root. Bandwidth ratio 5:1 — at 10 TB stored you get 50 TB/mo, enough for 30 TB serving but with a hard edge. Coupon BFBOX (40% recurring) is widely cited on LET and moves the effective price materially; the list price is what is recorded below.
reliability_note: Multiple positive LET reviews over 12+ months ('uptime + speed has me impressed', 'genuinely, I couldn't be a happier customer'). One documented US storage-box migration with TB-scale accounts moved by batched rsync. Crypto payments are explicitly non-refundable (7-day money-back applies to card/PayPal only).

evidence.proved: 'Storage 1 TB from €2.50/mo', capacity ladder 500GB/1TB/2TB/4TB/8TB/16TB, 'Bandwidth 2.5 TB' on the 500 GB model, RAID-60 + NVMe cache, 10 Gbps, DirectAdmin
500 GB billed €7.00 per YEAR (≈€1.17/TB/mo), confirming the annual price is real and not a teaser
'€57/year with the recurring coupon BFBOX (40% off), StorageBox 4 TB, 20 TB bandwidth, Falkenstein'
